summary.text: If someone you do not know appointed you, decline the request in Account settings.

steps.name: Decline the request
steps.text: If the person who appointed you is not known to you, go to the “Trusted Contacts” section under your Account settings and decline the request.

items: If the person who appointed you is not known to you, go to the “Trusted Contacts” section under your Account settings.

example_phrasings: An unknown party has appointed me as their Trusted Contact. What should I do?
Someone I don’t know made me their Trusted Contact. What should I do?

quotes.text: If you have received a Trusted Contact appointment request from a person not known to you, you can decline the request at the “Trusted Contacts” section under your Account settings.
